context_requirements: Functional PTGIR expression on the target cell type
A cell context in which IP receptor activation drives a transcriptional program; most adherent cancer lines in this panel are not expected to meet this
falsifiers: Reproducible induction of cAMP-responsive immediate-early genes such as FOS, JUN, EGR1 or NR4A family members at 6 h in any line
Consistent PTGIR-dependent transcriptional signature across multiple lines
Dose-dependent transcriptional changes at 10 micromolar that are absent in PTGIR-negative controls
